notes: Expression benchmark with mixed provenance; no claim that all source quantities are raw counts. Absolute lambda grid is frozen without data; no held-out data determine its endpoints. Rebutal4: exclusion of single-age studies from all training partitions (A, A_repeated, B, C, final); otherwise identical to rebutal3 production.
inverse_stratum_definition: inverse training frequency of split_age_stratum, normalized to mean one; legacy weights are missing for 34 profiles
training_exclusion_definition: Within each outer training set, drop studies with one distinct age_week before any filtering, selection, inner CV or fitting. Test sets are unchanged.
